stories.title: Iceland votes to reject EU membership talks
new_facts: Final result: 'No' prevails, overturning the earlier 'yes' lead; ties vote to Trump's Greenland-annexation threats.
Gives precise final tally: No 52.8% to Yes 47.2%.
Reports near-final overnight count (52.5% No) with one of six districts left, citing fishing concerns.
Reports Reykjavik was the only area with a 'Yes' majority.
New story: Iceland holds EU referendum on resuming membership talks; result too close to call as counting continues
Official count confirms 'No' win; notes record referendum turnout and overnight swing.
Notes Iceland remains part of the EEA and Schengen despite rejecting EU accession talks.
Analysis: well-funded 'no' campaign accused of scaremongering; question wording may have swayed the vote.
stories.line: Iceland voters rejected reopening EU membership negotiations in a referendum, citing fishing rights and geopolitical concerns.

stories.title: NASA launches Roman Space Telescope after years of development
new_facts: Telescope actually launched Aug. 30 aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket, confirming liftoff occurred
Telescope heading to an observation point 1 million miles from Earth, launched from Kennedy Space Center
New specs: 300-megapixel imaging capability and expected discovery of tens of thousands of exoplanets
Described as tour-bus-sized; expected to identify more than 100,000 exoplanets
stories.line: NASA launched its Roman Space Telescope to map distant galaxies and search for exoplanets with higher resolution than existing observatories.
